newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's oil reserves seen at 2.79 bln barrels.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's oil reserves seen at 2.79 bln barrels.

text.p: Colombia's "remaining" reserves of crude oil stood at 2.79 billion barrels as of last year, 154 million barrels less than in 1995, the state oil company Ecopetrol said in a report Friday.

The report noted that the figure did not take into account the giant Piedemonte block in Colombia's eastern plains, however. The field, which is still largely unexplored, has been estimated to contain between 500 million and 1 billion barrels of condensates in three separate hydrocarbon formations.
In its report, which gave no figure for proven oil reserves, Ecopetrol also said Colombia's natural gas reserves had been estimated at 7.6 billion cubic feet as of late last year.
